translations.web: If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.
translations.bsb: And if he finds it, truly I tell you, he rejoices more over that one sheep than over the ninety-nine that did not go astray.
translations.kjv: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.
